notes.title: 🎉 Update Announcement for Odania Sports Arena! 🚀
notes.content:
A huge thank you to you, our loyal players! Your feedback is incredibly important to us and has helped us improve the game. A special thanks goes to all the testers who participated at the[b] Baltic Games Fest in Neumünster[/b] last week. Your engagement and feedback have made a real difference!

✨[b] What’s New?[/b] Based on your valuable comments, we have already adjusted the scoring system to provide a fairer and more exciting gaming experience.

We look forward to bringing you more great updates and can’t wait for your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the [b]Odania Sports Arena[/b] community! Stay tuned for more exciting developments! 🌟

notes.title: 🎉 Big Update for Odania Sports Arena: It's Time to Return! 🚀
notes.content:
After over a year of hard work and creative improvements, we are proud to announce a major update for [b]Odania Sports Arena[/b]! 🎮✨

🌟 [b]What’s New?[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Completely Reworked Assets:[/b] We’ve fully revamped the visual elements of the game to provide you with an even more engaging and vibrant gaming experience!
[*] [b]Help the All-Knowing Cat![/b] Now you can help the adorable all-knowing cat focus while defending it against evil bombs and wasps. Get ready for exciting challenges!
[*] [b]Overhauled Balancing:[/b] We’ve rebalanced the entire game and need your feedback for further improvements. Your input is important to us!
[*] [b]Adjustable Platform Size:[/b] You can now customize the platform size to suit your preferred play style!
[*] [b]Individual Player Size Settings[/b]: Options are now available that allow each player to adjust the size according to their needs.
[*] [b]One-Handed Mode and Red-Green Weakness Mode:[/b] To make the game accessible for everyone, we’ve added a handy one-handed mode and a mode for red-green colorblind players.
[*] [b]Cute Design:[/b] Enjoy an adorable design featuring the cat and lively balls with eyes, making the gameplay even more entertaining!
[/list]

🚀 [b]Your Feedback Matters![/b] We can’t wait to hear what you think of the update! Visit us on the Steam page, try out the new features, and let us know your thoughts. Your feedback helps us improve Odania Sports Arena!

🤩 [b]Get ready for fun, challenges, and cat magic![/b]
Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more exciting news!

notes.title: Update v1.5
notes.content:
The new version v1.5 is released on steam. It contains several updates:

[h3]Updated UI[/h3]

The UI has received a massive update. There are now three screens including a new Help and Credits Screen.

[h3]Added Music[/h3]

Background music is now available in the game. You can control the volume of the music and sound effects in the settings menu.

[h3]Added Steam Achievements[/h3]

Steam achievements for every play type are now available

[h3]Added Localization[/h3]

The game is now localized to english and german
